author: Idaho-Lefty
notes_extra: 140 gr. Berger Classics. 24 in Tikka T-3. Groups about 1/2 MOA. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 270 wsm. The January 6, 2024 post is the same charge with a later velocity.

author: Idaho-Lefty
notes_extra: 140 gr. Classic Hunter. Tikka 24 in stainless T-3. Magazine length. Jumping .105 to the throat. Groups about 3/4 MOA, 1.5 in at 200 yards, and 3.5 to 6 in at 700 yards. The same-day post gave 3,173 fps average and a bull elk through both shoulders at 115 yards.
